harshVerdictSummary: DanteClicky dominates 3 of 6 domains (Memory 8.75, Computer Use 7.90, UX 8.00). Leads Screenpipe by +1.98 overall. Critical gaps: Dim 38 (ambient UX = 3), Dim 29 (local vision = 0), Dim 50 (OSS = 5), Dim 47 (cross-platform = 3). Next 4 sprints (dims 38→8→50→29) yield +0.32 composite to 7.90/10.

closed_source.verdict: 24/7 memory leader but lacks CU + voice. DC superior on active use.

closed_source.name: Raycast AI
closed_source.verdict: macOS launcher. Not competitor for Windows agent.

closed_source.name: Wispr Flow
closed_source.verdict: Voice-input tool, not agent. DC multilingual catch-up + local vision will surpass.

open_source.name: UI-TARS Desktop
open_source.verdict: Headless CU reference. DC extends with voice + memory.

Voice.verdict: DC leads on active voice (PTT + TTS). Loses on passive (multilingual, wake-word). Wispr 5.1 multilingual strong point.

Screen.verdict: DC tied with Screenpipe (7.34 vs 7.4). Critical gap: Dim 16 (video/temporal = 2 vs Screenpipe 9). DC excels at UI tree (9.4).
gaps: Dim 16: Video/temporal moat (Screenpipe 9) — architecture change required

Computer Use.verdict: DC DOMINANT (7.90 vs UI-TARS 7.8). Best-in-class SoM, safety, system prompt (only 10/10). Critical gap: Dim 29 (local vision = 0).

Memory.verdict: DC UNQUESTIONABLE LEAD (+1.08 vs Screenpipe). 9.3 memory privacy is hardest-earned score (SQLCipher AES-256 verified). Consolidation + preference learning both 9.2.

UX.verdict: DC strong (8.0 vs Cluely 7.0). Critical gap: Dim 38 (ambient UX = 3 vs Screenpipe 9). Screenpipe passive tray-mode moat.
gaps: Dim 38: Ambient/always-on UX (Screenpipe 9) — 4-point lift = +0.08 composite HIGHEST PRIORITY

Platform.verdict: DC weakest domain (6.33 vs Goose 6.8). Gaps: Dim 47 (cross-platform = 3, macOS port 3+ days), Dim 50 (OSS = 5, 1-day fix).

next_priorities.why: Screenpipe's #1 moat (9). Passive tray-mode: periodic screenshot+OCR diff, ambient context buffer, no PTT required. Implementation: setInterval(ambientTick, 30s) + OCR diff gate (>10% change) + context buffer injection. 4-point lift = +0.08 composite = HIGHEST PRIORITY.
next_priorities.implementation_sketch:
1. Tray thread: loop every 30s if ambient_enabled
2. Capture screenshot+OCR diff vs last
3. If >10% delta: inject '[AMBIENT] {diff summary}' into context buffer
4. UI: Settings toggle 'Ambient Mode' + status indicator
5. Tests: Verify diff gate, buffer injection, no performance hit

next_priorities.implementation_sketch:

4. Inject '[LANGUAGE: {lang}]' in Whisper system prompt

2. Add moondream2 to src/vision.rs (candle inference)

overinflated_dims.verdict: DC 9.0 is defensible (numbered badges, element state, 20-element limit). UI-TARS 10 is reference impl. Consider 8.8 in next rescore, but current 9.0 justified given UI-TARS headless advantage.

underestimated_dims.verdict: DC 9.4 is justified. UIAutomation state-tracking (focused/checked/expanded) + multi-monitor correctness + disabled element filtering beats Screenpipe 4 significantly. Consider raising to 9.5 in next rescore.
DC 9.2 justified. Jaccard word-overlap dedup (>0.65), fact cap 50, atomic eviction, clear_turns idempotence, 'Consolidate now' UI beats Screenpipe 8 (basic dedup). Consider 9.3 next rescore.

DC 9.3 VERIFIED. SQLCipher AES-256 (Perl 5.38.2 via .cargo/config.toml, test_sqlcipher_migration_encrypts_existing_db passes), ChaCha20 field-level, DPAPI OS-level key, retention enforced, DataInventory+incognito UI. Hard-won. Justified.

hard_ceilings.why: Requires always-listening microphone (privacy nightmare). Screenpipe 3. Wispr 4 (voice-input focus). DC hard ceiling at 2 unless major UX shift (opt-in always-listening, clearly disclosed).
hard_ceilings.action: Defer unless user explicitly requests; privacy trade-off not justified for DC's non-voice-first positioning.

hard_ceilings.why: Screenpipe's moat (24/7 video recording + temporal buffer). DC screenshot-polled architecture (no video). Architectural change required (video stream handling, frame buffering, temporal indexing).
hard_ceilings.action: Defer. Not in next 4 sprints (requires 3-5 days + UX redesign).

hard_ceilings.why: Windows-only Tauri 2.0 app. macOS port = 3+ days (Tauri macOS setup, native code review, signing). Linux = lower priority.
hard_ceilings.action: Intentional scoping. Defer until after next 4 dims (total work: 7+ days).

hard_ceilings.why: Closed repo (intentional for competitive secrets). Can reach 8/10 with public GitHub + LICENSE + cargo deny audit, but true OSS (public source) only if open-sourcing.
hard_ceilings.action: FIXABLE (1 day): public GitHub + LICENSE + cargo deny = 8/10. Full OSS (9-10) requires source disclosure decision.

harsh_scoring_notes.methodology: Each dimension re-scored by comparing DC to nearest competitor (domain-specific). Overinflation checked: is DC 9+ justified vs leader? Underestimation checked: does DC score match effort/verification vs competitors?
harsh_scoring_notes.verification_status: Dims 3, 17, 22, 26, 28, 30, 35, 36 verified in code (test coverage >80%). Dims 33, 34 verified in session 11 (20 trait types, FTS5 dedup).
competitive_pressure_points: Dim 38 (ambient) — Screenpipe moat (9). DC at 3 is vulnerability.
Dim 16 (video) — Screenpipe moat (9). DC at 2 is acceptance of scope.
Dim 29 (local vision) — UI-TARS moat (9). DC at 0 is hard floor.
Dim 8 (multilingual) — Wispr strength (7). DC at 3 is fixable in 1 day.
Dim 50 (OSS) — All OSS competitors 8-9. DC at 5 is intentional (closed repo).
